Get one item in Zotero's native JSON

Source: R/item.R
cz_get_item.Rd

Returns the item as Zotero stores it (not CSL-JSON): writable fields are in $data, and $version is the item version used for safe updates.

Usage

cz_get_item(item, auth = cz_auth(), cache = getOption("citezot.cache", FALSE))

Arguments

item

The item: a DOI, Zotero item ID, citekey, or one-row result of cz_find() (see cz_pin_key()).

auth

Credentials from cz_auth().

cache

Passed to cz_fetch_items() when item has to be looked up.

Value

A list with key, version, data and other API fields.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
item <- cz_get_item("Darwin1859")
item$data$title
item$version
} # }
